scientific_integrity.claim_scope: iid uniform row draws; identity linear system; constant alpha and nonnegative beta; synchronized starts
scientific_integrity.computational_validation: independent symbolic and finite checks corroborate, not substitute for infinite proof

scientific_limitations: No guarantee for nonorthogonal matrices or nonuniform/dependent sampling.
Special alpha=1/2, r=1 cases have existing Kaczmarz analysis.
No global rate-optimal momentum or almost-sure instability claim.
Potential unlocated equivalent stochastic-recurrence results remain an originality risk.
title: Exact momentum and relaxation frontiers for randomized multi-reflection Douglas–Rachford on identity systems
